build_fir_filter: apply an FIR lowpass or highpass filter to a numpy signal array with matched initial conditions
create_fir_coefficients_states: compute FIR filter coefficients and initial steady state for real-time sample-by-sample filtering
test_check_symmetry: check if FIR filter coefficients are symmetric or antisymmetric and return a boolean result
summarize_symmetric_fir_group_delay: calculate the group delay in samples for a symmetric or antisymmetric FIR filter
refactor_fir_filter: refactor the FIR filter function to support bandpass or bandstop filter types beyond lowpass and highpass
